__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: CoreLink GC metrics datasource (Prometheus / VictoriaMetrics / Grafana Cloud)

title: CoreLink — Garbage Collection (DASH-GC)
description: WI-S06-007 §6.1.1 canonical 10-panel GC dashboard. Mirrors DASH-AC + DASH-MULTIPART pattern. Panels: phase rates per region; reclaim bytes per tenant_tier (customer-visible CAP-GC-006); INV-GC-004 violations counter (CRITICAL alert >0); refcount drift global+per-tenant max; sweeper tick rate per region; orphan candidate count per tenant; phase-budget exceeded counter; degrade-mode `gc-pause` active gauge; TLA+ CI 30d sustained verde gauge (S-20 GA gate); SLO-CORRECT-GC + SLO-FRESH-GC sustained.

panels.title: Mark / Sweep / PhysicalDelete / Reconcile — phase rates per region (rolling 5-min)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 1. Each phase emits `phase_duration_ms` histogram + `run_completed_total` counter; rate of completed runs per region surfaces phase throughput. Mark p99 ≤ 10 min @ 1M blobs; sweep p99 ≤ 5 min @ 100k candidates; physical-delete p99 ≤ 30 min @ 100k; reconcile p99 ≤ 1h @ 1M (sprint contract §5.3 / §5.4 / §5.5).

panels.title: Reclaim bytes per tenant_tier (customer-visible CAP-GC-006)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 2 + sprint contract §14.s06.7 + DoD §10.s06.3. `corelink_gc_reclaimed_bytes_total{tenant_id, tier}` aggregated per tier. Surfaces customer-visible business metric `bytes_reclaimed_last_30d` (S-09 forward). > 0 in synthetic workload is canonical S-06 DoD gate.

panels.title: INV-GC-004 violations counter (CRITICAL alert if > 0)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 3 + sprint contract §6 DoD invariant. `corelink_gc_inv_gc_004_violations_total` MUST always = 0. `>0` sustained 1 min = SEV-0 PagerDuty page Architect + Crypto SME. Cross-validated by 100k race property test (`prop_inv_gc_004_race`) + TLA+ `gc_correctness.tla::InvGCReRefProtected` 30d sustained gate.

panels.title: Refcount drift % global + per-tenant max
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 4 + sprint contract §5.5 R-S06-10 + §10.s06.5. Global drift > 0.1% sustained = SEV-2; per-tenant drift > 1% sustained = SEV-1. Auto-fix gate fires when count ≤ 5 AND percent ≤ 0.01% (Lote 10.6bis P0-6 dual condition).

panels.title: Sweeper tick rate per region (alert if cron stale > 1h)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 5. Cron canonical cadence = daily 02:00 UTC + jitter ±10 min per region. Tick rate < 1/24h sustained > 1h = SEV-1 (RB-FM-305 chaos #1: cron not re-armed). Mirrors DASH-MULTIPART panel 5 pattern with different cadence.

panels.title: Orphan candidate count per tenant (top 10)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 6. Per-tenant `gc_candidates` row count `WHERE status='candidate'`; high count signals slow mark phase or backlog. Top 10 surfaces investigation candidates without overwhelming the panel.

panels.title: Phase budget exceeded counter (Mark / Sweep / PhysicalDelete / Reconcile)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 7 + sprint contract §5.3 R-S06-7.1 / §5.4 R-S06-9.1 / §5.5 R-S06-10.1. Per-phase budget enforced: mark 10 min, sweep 5 min, physical-delete 30 min, reconcile 1h. Budget exceeded = `PhaseBudgetExceeded` error returned + `RunFailed` audit. Sustained > 0 = SEV-2 page Architect + SRE.

panels.title: Degrade-mode `gc-pause` active gauge
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 8 + sprint contract §5.1 R-S06-3 + PAT-DEGRADE-001. Gauge `corelink_gc_degrade_mode_active{kind}` = 1 when non-Off, 0 otherwise. Sustained > 1h sem ADR = SEV-2 (operational risk; long pause increases reclaim debt).

panels.title: TLA+ CI 30d sustained verde gauge (S-20 GA promotion gate)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 9 + sprint contract §6 DoD §10.s06.4 + Critério Promoção. `corelink_ci_tla_30d_sustained_verde{spec="gc_correctness"}` = 1 when 30 consecutive nightly runs verde; 0 otherwise. Required pre-S-20 GA promotion. CI red sustained > 4h resets clock per WI §1.7 sustained-verification semantics.

panels.title: SLO-CORRECT-GC + SLO-FRESH-GC sustained
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 10 + slo_catalog. SLO-CORRECT-GC: zero blobs reachable deletados (binary; INV-GC-001 + INV-GC-004 sustained 0 violations). SLO-FRESH-GC: orphan reclaim p99 ≤ 14d (= grace 72h + reconcile cycle 24h + headroom). Both sustained 30d staging is the GA gate.
